name: Drawer
summary: Panel that slides in from a screen edge.

props.name: title
props.description: The <h2> in the header, and the accessible name.

props.name: footer
props.description: The actions row, at the end, with 8 between the buttons. Left out, there is no footer.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Escape, backdrop and close button all route here.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge it slides from — all four, as in the reference library; bottom is the panel that rises on a phone. left/right are PHYSICAL sides. The side ones are 320 wide on a phone and 384 from 640 up (never more than 85% of the screen), with the 22 corner on the inner side; top and bottom take the full width and up to 85% of the height, with the 32 sheet corner and the 36 × 4 handle. A swipe toward its edge closes it. The default is right (the reference library's is bottom).
